dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm very happy to have someplace to settle down for a time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When I'm by myself, I often look outside just to appreciate the scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: With no one around, one's heart will naturally calm.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Tomorrow is uncertain, but at least I'll always have the stability of the present.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A pity that I can't reside here for long, for my blade will dull.

choices.text: You can come here for a rest whenever you want.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Each year yields scorching summers and frigid winters. The hottest and coldest days are difficult for me to weather.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But the weather here is always comfortable...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It is truly a blessing to leisurely pass one's time here.
